name: aylayoo-web
// why: This app lives in a monorepo but is also pushed to the Aylay-oo team's own repo via `git subtree push --prefix=apps/aylayoo`. There it has no root to inherit from, so its dependencies are declared here. Inside the monorepo these are already satisfied by the root install and nothing resolves differently. Versions match what the monorepo resolves today.

scripts.// deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is inlined by `next build`, so it must be set for these two, not as a Worker var.
scripts.cf:preview: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://aylayoo-service.sbolorsaikhan4.workers.dev next build && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.cf:deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://aylayoo-service.sbolorsaikhan4.workers.dev next build && opennextjs-cloudflare build --skipNextBuild && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
